g.text: Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 domain model (view 1 of 2)
Encapsulation: state transitions own their guards.
Stores Order but never calls it.
Regular: loss 8, 0%; cycle, combo at index % 3 = 0 if offered.
VIP: loss 5, 10%; cycle. Critic: loss 12, 0%; always Pasta.
All three override typeName() as well.
Object composition: two existing items are retained and shared.
Hollow diamonds reflect shared components, not exclusive ownership.
Salad + Pasta = 2430 cents, 3 units; Menu.base() stays unchanged.
Encapsulation: preparation and status transitions live here.
Personal discount, then Happy Hour 20%; half up at each step.
billCents is final; later activation/expiry cannot change it.
customerDiscountPercent: int, placedTurn: int, happyHourActive: boolean)
+ public; # protected; - private. {readOnly} means final/immutable value.
Solid arrows: stored object references. Dashed arrows: dependency or explicit ID lookup.
Black diamond: internally created lifetime-owned part. Hollow diamond: shared aggregation.
A customer has at most one order/table in reachable gameplay; ID links are not object fields.
Key members shown; packages are under restaurantrush. Controller and CLI appear in view 2.
Source baseline: d38231a (merged Stage 3 integration). See README.md for scope and trace evidence.
